response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), totals AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(member_count) AS average_member_count FROM major_counts) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / total_members AS fraction_of_members, member_count * 1.0 / average_member_count AS ratio_to_average FROM major_counts CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, major_id LIMIT 10;
